traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: Gorson’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components. * At will: detect magic, charm person * 3/day each: dispel magic, lightning bolt, suggestion, wall of fire

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text:
Gorson has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that
rely on smell.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
traits.text:
If Gorson fails a saving throw, it can
choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The devil has advantage on saving throws against
spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapon
traits.text: The devil’s weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.text:
If Gorson moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then
hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 21
Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, Gorson can
make one claw attack or one battleaxe attack as a bonus action against it.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.text:
With a 10-foot running start, Gorson can long jump up
to 50 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
Gorson makes two attacks with its claw, and then two
battleaxe attacks or two slam attacks. If it uses the battleaxe two-handed,
it can’t also make claw attacks that turn.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target.
Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) slashing damage, or 28 (4d10 + 6) slashing damage if
used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20
(4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20
(4d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Summon (1/day)
actions.text:
Gorson summons 2d6 bearded devils, 2d4 barbed
devils, 1 bone devil, or 1 erinyes. The summoned devil appears in an
unoccupied space within 60 feet of Gorson, but can’t summon other
devils. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Gorson is slain, or until Gorson
takes an action to dismiss it.
